title: 3rd Stopping Place 2nd Truth The Universal Mercy Of Mercifulness And The Faculties Given To Man For Benefiting From It

questions.question: What is one gift mentioned in the passage that helps people enjoy many different foods?
questions.answer: A stomach that can enjoy many kinds of food.

questions.question: Besides food, what does human life help us benefit from in the physical world?
questions.answer: It helps us benefit from many blessings in the world through our senses.

questions.question: Which two inner gifts are named as tools for enjoying both spiritual and physical blessings?
questions.answer: The intellect and the heart.

questions.question: What does Islam help people receive from the unseen and seen worlds?
questions.answer: It helps them receive light from both.

questions.question: What does faith do for a person according to the passage?
questions.answer: It brightens a person with many blessings and lights from this life and the next.

questions.question: What example is used to describe the universe and Allah’s mercy in it?
questions.answer: The universe is described like a palace filled with precious things.

questions.question: In that palace example, what is given to human beings?
questions.answer: People are given keys and also needs and senses to benefit from what is there.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about mercy in this world and the next?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah’s mercy reaches both worlds and everything in them.

questions.question: What does that wide mercy show about Allah?
questions.answer: It shows His oneness.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: Allah has given people many gifts and His mercy reaches everything.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention the stomach first?
questions.answer: To give a simple example of how Allah made us able to enjoy His blessings.

questions.question: How is life described as a blessing in the passage?
questions.answer: Life lets us use our senses to benefit from many things in the world.

questions.question: How is being human shown as a special favor?
questions.answer: It lets us enjoy both material and spiritual gifts through the mind and heart.

questions.question: What extra blessing is added after human abilities are mentioned?
questions.answer: Islam is given so people can receive light from the unseen and visible realms.

questions.question: After Islam, what further guidance is mentioned?
questions.answer: Guidance to faith.

questions.question: How does the palace example help the reader understand mercy?
questions.answer: It shows that the world is full of valuable gifts and that people are given ways to use them.

questions.question: What do the “keys” in the palace example help us understand?
questions.answer: They help us understand that Allah gives people access to many blessings.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage make from all these examples of mercy?
questions.answer: Such mercy is a clear sign of Allah’s oneness within unity.

questions.question: What body part in the passage is connected with enjoying many kinds of food?
questions.answer: The stomach.

questions.question: What lets us gain from the many blessings in the physical world?
questions.answer: The senses that come with life.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the human condition higher than simple bodily life?
questions.answer: Because it lets us enjoy gifts from both the physical and spiritual sides of creation.

questions.question: Which human abilities are directly named for enjoying those wider gifts?
questions.answer: The intellect and the heart.

questions.question: What is one way Islam benefits a person in the passage?
questions.answer: It brings light from the treasures of the unseen and seen worlds.

questions.question: What is one way faith benefits a person in the passage?
questions.answer: It brings light from the blessings of this world and the hereafter.

questions.question: In the passage, why is the universe compared to a palace?
questions.answer: Because it is presented as carefully prepared and filled with valuable things by Divine mercy.

questions.question: What two things are given to people so they can benefit from that “palace”?
questions.answer: Keys to open its treasures, and needs and senses to use them.

questions.question: If mercy reaches this life, the next life, and all things, what does that suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the One giving that mercy is one over all.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah gave people so they can enjoy many different foods?
questions.answer: He gave them a stomach.

questions.question: What do our senses allow us to do in the world of bodies and physical things?
questions.answer: They allow us to benefit from countless blessings there.

questions.question: How do the mind and heart help a person?
questions.answer: They help a person enjoy wide gifts from both the spiritual and physical worlds.

questions.question: What was given so people could take light from hidden and visible treasures?
questions.answer: Islam.

questions.question: What was given so people could be brightened by blessings from both this world and the next?
questions.answer: Faith.

questions.question: What picture does the passage use for the universe?
questions.answer: It uses the picture of a richly furnished palace.

questions.question: What fills this palace in the passage?
questions.answer: Many precious and beautiful things prepared by Divine mercy.

questions.question: Why are people said to have keys, needs, and senses in this picture?
questions.answer: Because Allah made them able to reach and use those blessings.

questions.question: What belief does the passage connect with this all-reaching mercy?
questions.answer: The belief that Allah is One.

questions.question: Name one physical blessing and one spiritual blessing mentioned in the passage.
questions.answer: A physical blessing is the stomach, and a spiritual blessing is faith.

questions.question: What is the connection between life and the senses in the passage?
questions.answer: Life includes senses that help us benefit from many blessings in the world.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both the intellect and the heart?
questions.answer: To show that people can enjoy blessings not only with the body but also inwardly.

questions.question: What does Islam open for people according to the passage?
questions.answer: It opens light from the treasures of the unseen and visible worlds.

questions.question: What does faith open for people according to the passage?
questions.answer: It opens light and blessings from this life and the next.

questions.question: What does the palace image teach about the universe?
questions.answer: It teaches that the universe is prepared with care and full of valuable gifts.

questions.question: In the palace image, what do the chests and rooms suggest?
questions.answer: They suggest many kinds of blessings waiting to be used.

questions.question: Why is it important that people are given needs and senses along with the keys?
questions.answer: Because they need abilities as well as access in order to benefit from the blessings.

questions.question: What is meant by saying mercy is a sign of “oneness within unity”?
questions.answer: It means one Allah gives His mercy to many different things everywhere.

questions.question: What everyday example does the passage use to show that Allah made people able to enjoy His provisions?
questions.answer: It uses the example of the stomach enjoying many foods.

questions.question: How does the passage move from the body to bigger blessings?
questions.answer: It goes from food and senses to the mind, heart, Islam, and faith.

questions.question: What does human life allow us to enjoy beyond food alone?
questions.answer: It allows us to enjoy many blessings in the physical world through our senses.

questions.question: What special honor comes with being human in the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings can enjoy gifts from both spiritual and material worlds.

questions.question: What role does Islam have in the passage?
questions.answer: It helps people receive light from the unseen and the visible realms.

questions.question: What role does faith have in the passage?
questions.answer: It helps people receive light and gifts from both this world and the hereafter.

questions.question: Why is the universe compared to a palace full of treasures?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s mercy has filled it with countless valuable blessings.

questions.question: What shows that humans were made to benefit from that palace?
questions.answer: They were given keys, needs, and senses to make use of what is in it.

questions.question: What final truth about Allah is drawn from this mercy that reaches everything?
questions.answer: It proves His oneness.
